messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high-severity — interregion routing loop detected. Healthy probe flapping observed across us-east <-> us-west <-> eu for model-routing-group:gen2. Affected: 2.1% of requests, transient 502s and increased tail latency. Auto-fallback tripped repeatedly. Paging oncall team.

alice oncall-eng: oncall here. seeing alerts, pulling traces.

alice oncall-eng: quick summary: KV-cache misses spike when fallback happens, followed by model-variant mismatch errors and OOMs on some nodes in eu. Logs show fallback policy cycling every ~30s.

bob sre: adding context — we rolled routing-policy v2 last week that introduced 'region_hesitancy_ms' and variant fallback chains. suspect config bug + uneven probe sensitivity.

carol platform: @alice can you dump the routing policy snapshot and last 5 probe events? i'll prep a rollback path.

alice oncall-eng: paste: ```json
{"policy":"v2","fallback_chain":["same-region-fp16","peer-region-fp16","peer-region-int8"],"region_hesitancy_ms":15000}
```

alice oncall-eng: probe events (trimmed): ```
us-east -> healthy
us-west -> fail: probe 502
eu -> healthy
us-west -> fail: probe 502
us-east -> fail: probe 502
eu -> fail: probe 502
``` 

dan support: any customer impact? getting reports of 502s from a handful of SaaS customers.

eve runtime: i pulled a trace where fallback picked peer-region-int8 and that node OOM'd during kv-cache restore. The chain then falls back again and requeues, creating a loop. Probably the int8 variant isn't fully compatible for this model (kv-size mismatch).

bob sre: action plan: 1) disable cross-region int8 fallback, 2) raise hesitancy to avoid thrash, 3) pin affected customers to their home region while we root cause.

carol platform: i can flip policies. doing a targeted policy patch for routing-group:gen2 -> remove peer-region-int8 from chain.

carol platform: command i'll run: ```bash
redwoodctl routing set --group gen2 --remove-fallback peer-region-int8 --dry-run=false
``` 

alice oncall-eng: +1. also bump hesitancy to 60000ms so healthchecks need stable failures to flip.

carol platform: applying now... ```ok: policy updated (rolling)``` :hourglass_flowing_sand:

frank infra-bot: Deploy pipeline started for policy-change gen2; rollout to us-west first.

alice oncall-eng: monitoring metrics. 502 rate for gen2 dropping from 2.1% -> 0.3% in last 60s. kv-cache restore errors ↓.

dan support: letting impacted customers know we've applied hotfix and are monitoring. drafting note with ETA.

eve runtime: i'm also going to add a guard in runtime to reject int8 fallback when kv_cache_size mismatch to avoid OOM path — quick patch queued.

bob sre: good. we should also add regression test in canary for fallback chain order.

alice oncall-eng: confirmed: fallback oscillation stopped after policy change and hesitancy bump. keeping thread open for next hour for stability.

carol platform: rolling full rollout now. ```ok: rollout complete``` :white_check_mark:

alice oncall-eng: last check: 502s back to baseline. tail latency normalized. marking incident mitigated. will open a postmortem PR with timeline and config diff.

dan support: customers notified; one account asked for compensated tokens. routing to account ops.

eve runtime: patch for mismatch guard is staged, will ship in next release.

bob sre: follow-ups: - postmortem + RCA - add metric that counts fallback chain hops per request - tighten config validation to disallow incompatible variant in fallback chain

alice oncall-eng: thanks team. tagging incident as Sev2 -> mitigated. closing pager.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated by policy change; followups assigned to platform/runtime/sre. Incident channel remain open for postmortem.
